authority: Brain World Model next decisive runs

invariant_rules.evaluation: same immutable held-out sessions/animals across compared scale points
invariant_rules.no_learned_identity: no learned session-ID or unit-ID embeddings in session-free runs
invariant_rules.report: per-fold/per-seed raw metrics plus aggregate; never report only best seed
invariant_rules.baselines: all baselines receive the same observable inputs unless the ablation explicitly removes one
invariant_rules.leakage: fit normalization/tokenizer/PCA/adapter statistics on training data only

strict_scaling.question: Does transferable neural forecasting improve with independent data scale once cell count and compute are controlled?

phase_C_capacity_at_information_scale.purpose: separate capacity bottleneck from 12-cell information bottleneck

strict_scaling.pass_logic: positive monotonic trend with data or neuron scale on immutable held-out evaluation; otherwise retain plateau as a genuine negative result

unseen_brain_adaptation.question: How much target data is required to adapt a shared backbone to an unseen brain?
unseen_brain_adaptation.split_rule: adaptation segment precedes and is disjoint from evaluation windows within each held-out target session/animal
unseen_brain_adaptation.pass_logic: shared-backbone methods reduce the target-data requirement versus scratch, especially at <=300 s

mcbride_counterfactual.question: Can the model predict the future cortical population trajectory conditional on the optogenetic action?
mcbride_counterfactual.pass_logic: true intervention improves future trajectory prediction over all counterfactual controls on held-out trials; prestim control should show no analogous advantage

required_outputs: single authority summary suitable for the public page
